summary: Implemented the full factoriolab witness vertical: core schema witness-angular-factoriolab.ts (barrel-exported), the angular-factoriolab AppSpec with a 7-stage journey (picker+tooltips, typed rate edit, columns dialog, settings display-rate, typed saved state, flow route, reload), the dedicated runner with the 'Select Columns' byte-mutation proof, generic WitnessMeasuredScrollAbsence, and the closed-list name. tsc, lint, 963 node tests and receipt:verify are green; both lanes were driven end-to-end and agree exactly. Canonical receipts were NOT produced: publishing aborts nondeterministically on a browser-cancelled duplicate fetch of the app's 1x1 placeholder image during bootstrap, which cannot be pinned exactly.
open_questions: Cut line: every `lab-icon` renders the same `assets/transparent.gif` as its ; under the origin's `cache-control: no-store` the browser refetches per element and cancels one of its own duplicates when Angular re-renders icons after the dataset resolves, yielding `GET /assets/transparent.gif net::ERR_ABORTED` in roughly 1 run in 3, during bootstrap and before any journey interaction. The exact failed-request inventory cannot represent a 0-or-1 count without becoming a blanket allowance. Which resolution does the goal want? (a) a new non-masking inventory category for browser-cancelled duplicate fetches of an asset the same page also fetched successfully, pinned by path+reason and checked against the successful fetch rather than by count; (b) drop `no-store` for loopback and stop intercepting loopback at the browser context so the memory cache coalesces duplicates — this changes the served-request ledger on the reload and would touch the diagnostic event stream that the pinned react-hospitalrun worker-script tally depends on; (c) something else. This is a harness-wide mechanism decision, not a factoriolab one, so it is above this unit.

Everything else is done and green; once the mechanism is chosen, the remaining work is one publish run plus packages/cli/test and packages/core/test cases for the new schema, then the whole-repo gate.
